column1: # TITLE: Circulating tumor cell analysis from stage III lung cancer patients
# SUMMARY: Imaging technologies only detect progression after it has occurred
column2: which may be well after tumor growth or disease progression has begun. In this work
column3: we determined whether circulating tumor cell (CTC) quantification
column5: or CTC gene expression can be used as a blood-based biomarker to predict patient outcomes in stage III NSCLC. The primary endpoint was disease progression
column8: or death. We used immunoaffinity graphene oxide (GO) chip to isolated CTCs from stage III NSCLC patients
column9: and extracted bulk RNA materials from isolated CTC samples and conducted microarray gene expression profiling.
